subject: Riverbend's 9% case-volume gap
body: Dr. Vasquez — your annual report cites a 9% YoY decline in cardiac case volume tied to turnover and staffing [E1], and your AHA panel comments suggest referrals are being turned away [E3]. Mercy Heart hit the same ceiling and recovered 14% weekly volume by restructuring room turnover without adding OR footprint [E4]. With the FY27 capex window closing in May, it's worth seeing whether that playbook fits Riverbend before the decision is locked. Would a 20-minute walk-through of Mercy's turnover data against your current schedule be useful the week of May 5?
cta: 20-min walk-through of Mercy's turnover data against your schedule, week of May 5.
